decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Before the development of units 20-24 commences the site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the Local Planning Authority for comment.  The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.

description: Following approval for the erection of 24 units (B1c, B2 and B8 use class) with ancillary trade counter use, together with associated ancillary offices, landscaping, servicing areas and car parking details submitted pursuant to Condition 18a (contamination)  of permission approved 15/8/8, specifically realting to units 1-19.
